items.source: NOTE: Actual transaction suspension will not work out-of-the-box on all transaction managers. This in particular applies to JtaTransactionManager, which requires the jakarta.transaction.TransactionManager to be made available to it (which is server-specific in standard Jakarta EE).
items.translation: 注意： 实际的事务挂起功能并非所有事务管理器都能开箱即用。这尤其适用于JtaTransactionManager，它需要向该管理器提供jakarta.transaction.TransactionManager（在标准的 Jakarta EE 中这是特定于服务器的）。

items.source: Note: For transaction managers with transaction synchronization, SUPPORTS is slightly different from no transaction at all, as it defines a transaction scope that synchronization will apply for. As a consequence, the same resources (JDBC Connection, Hibernate Session, etc) will be shared for the entire specified scope. Note that this depends on the actual synchronization configuration of the transaction manager.
items.translation: 注意：对于具有事务同步的事务管理器，`SUPPORTS` 与完全没有事务略有不同，因为它定义了一个同步将适用的事务范围。因此，相同的资源（如 JDBC 连接、Hibernate Session 等）将在整个指定的范围内共享。请注意，这取决于事务管理器的实际同步配置。

items.source: This is the default setting of a transaction annotation.
items.translation: 这是事务注解的默认设置。

items.source:
Note: Actual creation of a nested transaction will only work on specific
transaction managers. Out of the box, this only applies to the JDBC
DataSourceTransactionManager. Some JTA providers might support nested
transactions as well.
items.translation: 注意：实际创建嵌套事务仅在特定的事务管理器中有效。默认情况下，这仅适用于 `JDBCDataSourceTransactionManager`。某些 JTA 提供者也可能支持嵌套事务。

Analogous to EJB transaction attribute of the same name.

Analogous to EJB transaction attribute of the same name.

items.source: Enumeration that represents transaction propagation behaviors for use with the Transactional annotation, corresponding to the TransactionDefinition interface.
items.translation: 表示事务传播行为并可与 Transactional 注解一起使用的枚举，对应于 TransactionDefinition 接口。

items.source: Execute within a nested transaction if a current transaction exists, behave like REQUIRED otherwise.
items.translation: 如果当前存在事务，则在嵌套事务中执行；否则，表现得像 `<code>REQUIRED`。

items.source: Execute non-transactionally, suspend the current transaction if one exists.
items.translation: 非事务性地执行，如果存在当前事务则挂起该事务。

items.source: Support a current transaction, create a new one if none exists.
items.translation: 支持当前事务，如果不存在则创建一个新的。

items.source: Create a new transaction, and suspend the current transaction if one exists.
items.translation: 创建新事务，如果存在当前事务则挂起它。

items.source: Support a current transaction, execute non-transactionally if none exists.
items.translation: 支持当前事务，若不存在则非事务性地执行。
